decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording six tickets per referral-free mint and weighted-draw recipient selection.
The source changes commission allocation only for referral-free purchases; coded-referral commission recipients and payouts remain unchanged.
The source concerns tickets created by referral-free purchases and does not change ticket issuance for purchases using a valid referral code.

The approved FAQ states that no-referral commissions and tickets go to a random existing NFT holder; the source necessarily supersedes that description with six tickets and commission allocated by weighted draw.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: After 9 buys, why do only 8 tickets exist? Even a referral-free purchase should create 6 tickets and commission, with both allocated by weighted draw.

value_updates.approved_faq_copy: Retain the approved FAQ copy, but revise its no-referral rewards description to state that a referral-free purchase creates 6 tickets and commission, with both allocated by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners.

decisions.reason: The source changes reward allocation after a referral-free purchase, not the rules determining whether a supplied referral code is valid.
Weighted allocation for referral-free purchases does not change the token-serial source, permanence, or display of NFT referral identities.
The current landing-page requirements do not describe the recipient-selection rule for referral-free commissions or tickets.
The source changes which NFT owner receives rewards from a referral-free purchase; it does not change Small Block winner count, prize amount, trigger, eligibility, or pool funding.

The source requires a weighted draw for referral-free reward allocation but does not change the specified Chainlink VRF mechanism for Small Block prize-winner selection or identify Chainlink as the provider for this allocation draw.
The referral-free reward-allocation change has no effect on the badge set, icons, count, or dashboard layout.
The source changes the recipient-selection method for an existing no-referral commission and does not alter the mint price or monetary revenue split.
Allocating referral-free rewards by weighted draw does not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets follow an NFT after transfer.
